data.body: Allow larger authored compositions without an arbitrary node-count ceiling. Remove count restrictions consistently from compiler, runtime admission and saved-scene control snapshots; examine adjacent fixed graph quotas so the failure does not simply move. Retain cycle detection, valid resource provenance, byte/time/resource protections and actionable errors. Demonstrate a real scene with more than eight connected components, controls, save/reopen and failed-edit preview retention. Verify the original painting stays visually identical. Update/install authoring skills. One integrated review and merge. Needed now for the multi-pattern Living Ornament scene.
